## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pilot)

source("source/d2H_VSMOW_to_F2H.R")
source("source/calculate_mu.R")
source("source/calculate_sigma_mu.R")
```

import data

```{r}
# note the qtegra colnames that we'll re-insert into our trimmed xl file
qtegra_colnames <- readxl::read_excel("data/Athena_Data/qtegra_col_names.xlsx") |> 
  pull(col_id)

import_tidy_qtegra_export <- function(file_path) {
  readxl::read_excel(
    file_path, 
    skip = 4, # skip 4 rows of the qtegra output so it's just raw data
    col_names = qtegra_colnames, # put the col names back in at the top
    ) |> 
    janitor::clean_names() |> # remove punctuation and spaces from colnames
    # fill() takes blank data values and fills from the top down
    fill(
      c(index, user_name, start_time, stop_time, status, 
        mark_to_pause, label, comment, run_id, 
        analysis_no, evaluate, sample_type, vial, inject_volume_ml, inject),
      .direction = "down"
      ) |> 
    select(
      label, compound_name_2_00_m_z, 
      retention_time_2_00_m_z, peak_raw_area_2_00_m_z, h2_d2h
      ) |> 
    rename(
        rt_2mz_sec = retention_time_2_00_m_z,
        peak_area_2mz = peak_raw_area_2_00_m_z,
        d2H = h2_d2h,
        compound = compound_name_2_00_m_z,
        sample_id = label
      )
}

import_tidy_qtegra_export("data/Athena_Data/250623_TAC_soil_SIP_SET_1_FAMES.xlsx")


files_to_import = list.files(
  path = "data/Athena_Data/", 
  pattern = "SET", 
  full.names = TRUE)

all_data <- files_to_import |> 
  map_df(~ import_tidy_qtegra_export(.x) |> mutate(source = basename(.x)))
```

## Separate and reduce data

```{r}
F8_data <- all_data |> 
  filter(str_detect(sample_id, "F8"))

SIP_data <- all_data |> 
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "F8")) |> 
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "blank"),
         !str_detect(sample_id, "CLEAN"),
         !str_detect(sample_id, "BAME")) |> 
  mutate(
    clean_id = str_sub(sample_id, end = 5) |> str_remove("_")
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      str_sub(clean_id, end = 1) == "J" ~ "JCR",
      str_sub(clean_id, end = 1) == "L" ~ "LOM",
    ),
    drought = case_when(
      str_sub(clean_id, start = 2, end = 2) == "R" ~ "Drought",
      str_sub(clean_id, start = 2, end = 2) == "S" ~ "No Drought",
    ),
    SIP_type = case_when(
      str_sub(clean_id, start = 3, end = 3) == "W" ~ "Liquid-SIP",
      str_sub(clean_id, start = 3, end = 3) == "V" ~ "Vapor-SIP",
    ),
    dt_hr = parse_number(clean_id),
    replicate = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "_A") ~ "A",
      str_detect(sample_id, "_B") ~ "B"
    )
  ) |> 
  select(
    site, drought, SIP_type, everything()
  ) |> 
  # take mean of replicates
  group_by(clean_id, SIP_type, site, drought, dt_hr, compound) |> 
  #select(-c(rt_2mz_sec, peak_area_2mz)) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    d2H = mean(d2H, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt = mean(rt_2mz_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    area2 = mean(peak_area_2mz, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # remove H2 and standards
  filter(
    !compound %in% c("H2", "21:0 (STD)", "23:0 (STD)"),
    !is.na(compound)
  ) |> 
  # area cutoff
  filter(area2 > 1)


# print clean names
SIP_data |> pull(clean_id) |> unique()

# check compounds
SIP_data |> pull(compound) |> unique()

# histogram of areas
SIP_data |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(
    x = area2
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25) +
  pilot::theme_pilot()
```

```{r}
# inspect the data
SIP_data |>

      group = compound

```

## calculate weighted mean

```{r}
SIP_data_wm <- SIP_data |> 
  group_by(clean_id, SIP_type, site, drought, dt_hr) |> 
  dplyr::summarise(
    d2H = sum(area2 * d2H) / sum(area2)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(compound = "Weighted Mean") |> 
  bind_rows(SIP_data) |> 
  mutate(is_wm = if_else(compound == "Weighted Mean", TRUE, FALSE))

SIP_data_wm |> 
  filter(SIP_type == "Liquid-SIP") |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = dt_hr,
      y = d2H,
      group = compound
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(data = function(df) df |> filter(is_wm), color = "red") +
  geom_point(shape = 1, size = 2) +
  facet_grid(vars(SIP_type, site, drought)) +
  pilot::theme_pilot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Estimate F_L based on soil water content

```{r}
gwc <- readxl::read_excel("data/sample_matrix_complete.xlsx", sheet = "Gravimetric Water Content") |> 
  filter(
    sample_id != "EXAMPLE"
  ) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  filter(pre_or_post_rewetting == "PRE") |> 
  select(
    sample_id,
    site, 
    condition,
    gmc_percent
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    gwc = gmc_percent / 100, # convert to fraction
    ml_water_in_soil = 6 * gwc, # 6g soil
    F2H_soil_water = 0.00015576, # using VSMOW as placeholder
    ml_tracer_added = 6,
    F2H_tracer = 0.005,
    ml_incubation_soln = ml_tracer_added + ml_water_in_soil,
    F2H_incubation = ((ml_water_in_soil*F2H_soil_water) + (ml_tracer_added*F2H_tracer)) / ml_incubation_soln,
    drought = case_when(condition == "ROS" ~ "Drought",
                        condition == "SKY" ~ "No Drought")
  )

gwc_mini <- gwc |> 
  select(site, drought, FL = F2H_incubation)
```

## Growth estimates

```{r}
F0_data <- SIP_data_wm |> 
  filter(compound == "Weighted Mean") |> 
  filter(dt_hr == 0) |> 
  mutate(F0 = d2H_VSMOW_to_F2H(d2H, permil = TRUE)) |> 
  select(site, drought, F0)

growth_data <- SIP_data_wm |> 
  filter(compound == "Weighted Mean") |> 
  mutate(
    F2H = d2H_VSMOW_to_F2H(d2H, permil = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  # add in label FL data
  left_join(gwc_mini, by = join_by(site, drought)) |> 
  # add in F0 data
  left_join(F0_data, by = join_by(site, drought)) |> 
  # remove t0 data
  filter(dt_hr != 0) |> 
  # note what the previous time step is:
  mutate(
    t_minus_1 = case_when(
      dt_hr == 1 ~ 0,
      dt_hr == 3 ~ 1,
      dt_hr == 6 ~ 3,
      dt_hr == 24 ~ 6,
      dt_hr == 48 ~ 24,
      dt_hr == 72 ~ 48
    )
  ) |> 
  # calculate growth rate in d^-1
  mutate(
    u_d = calculate_mu(
      a = 0.71, 
      F2 = F2H,
      F1 = F0, 
      FL = FL,
      t2 = dt_hr / 24, 
      t1 = t_minus_1 / 24
      ),
    u_d = if_else(u_d < 0, 0, u_d),
    s_u_d = calculate_sigma_mu(
      a = 0.71,
      F2 = F2H,
      F1 = F0,
      FL = FL,
      t2 = dt_hr / 24,
      t1 = t_minus_1 / 24,
      sigma_a = 0.17,
      sigma_F1 = 0,
      sigma_FL = 0
    ),
    gen_d = log(2)/u_d
  )
```

plot growth

```{r}
p_growth <- growth_data |> 
  filter(SIP_type == "Liquid-SIP") |> 
  mutate(site = case_when(site == "JCR" ~ "Cattle Pasture", 
                          site == "LOM" ~ "Grassland")) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = dt_hr,
      y = u_d
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      ymin = u_d - s_u_d/2,
      ymax = u_d + s_u_d/2,
      fill = gen_d
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(begin = 1, end = 0) +
  facet_grid(site~drought, scale = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Time after rewetting (hr)",
    y = latex2exp::TeX("Growth Rate $(d^{-1})$"),
    fill = "Generation Time (days)"
  ) +
  pilot::theme_pilot() +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "left")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, angle = 90)
  )
p_growth

ggsave(
  plot = p_growth, 
  filename = "fig_output/growth_wetsip.png", 
  dpi = 1000, 
  height = 5, 
  width = 6
  )
```
